articles.title: African nations push fisheries transparency at global Mombasa summit
articles.titleCn: 非洲国家在全球蒙巴萨峰会上推动渔业透明度
articles.summary: African countries have been urged to accelerate fisheries transparency reforms to strengthen ocean governance, combat illegal fishing and protect the livelihoods of millions in coastal communities.
articles.summaryCn: 在肯尼亚蒙巴萨举行的第11届我们的海洋大会上，非洲国家呼吁加速渔业透明度改革，以加强海洋治理、打击非法捕捞并保护沿海社区生计。

paragraphs.en: The 11th Our Ocean Conference, held in Mombasa, Kenya, concluded on Thursday with a call for African countries to {{0}} fisheries {{1}} reforms as part of efforts to strengthen ocean {{2}}, combat {{3}} fishing and protect the {{4}} of millions in coastal communities. Held in Africa for the first time, the gathering provided a {{5}} for governments, conservation groups and maritime {{6}} to highlight the growing role of transparency, technology and international cooperation in {{7}} marine resources. Participants applauded countries such as Ghana and Cameroon for {{8}} transparency and {{9}} measures into national and regional fisheries policies. These efforts are helping African governments translate commitments into {{10}} actions aimed at tackling illegal, unreported and unregulated fishing while improving enforcement and promoting sustainable fisheries management. "What we've seen in Mombasa is clear evidence that ocean transparency is becoming a global expectation," said Tony Long, Chief Executive Officer of Global Fishing Watch.
paragraphs.cn: 第11届我们的海洋大会于周四在肯尼亚蒙巴萨闭幕，会议呼吁非洲国家加速渔业透明度改革，作为加强海洋治理、打击非法捕捞和保护沿海社区数百万人生计的一部分。这是该会议首次在非洲举行，为政府、保护组织和海洋利益相关方提供了一个平台，以强调透明度、技术和国际合作在保护海洋资源方面日益重要的作用。与会者赞扬了加纳和喀麦隆等国家将透明度和问责措施纳入国家和区域渔业政策。这些努力正在帮助非洲政府将承诺转化为具体行动，旨在解决非法、不报告和不管制的捕捞问题，同时加强执法并促进可持续渔业管理。全球渔业观察首席执行官托尼·朗表示：“我们在蒙巴萨看到的是明确证据，表明海洋透明度正成为全球期望。”

paragraphs.en:
"From new government commitments and partnerships to advances in technology and data, {{11}} is building around a simple principle: we cannot {{12}} manage what we cannot see. The challenge now is to turn that momentum into lasting action and make transparency the standard for every fishery, every vessel and every ocean around the world."
A photo of Amanzimtoti Beach near Durban, South Africa, December 11, 2020. /CFP
Technology driving transparency
A key focus of the conference was the growing use of technology to improve the {{13}} of fishing activities at sea. Global Fishing Watch showcased new research using {{14}} intelligence and high-resolution satellite {{15}} to reveal small-scale fishing activities that have traditionally remained beyond the reach of conventional monitoring systems. Presenting the findings, Chief Scientist David Kroodsma said the analysis identified more than 30,000 small-scale fishing vessels operating along Africa's coastline and highlighted areas where industrial and artisanal fisheries compete for the same resources.
paragraphs.cn: “从新的政府承诺和伙伴关系，到技术和数据的进步，围绕一个简单原则正在形成势头：我们无法可持续地管理我们看不见的东西。现在的挑战是将这一势头转化为持久的行动，并使透明度成为每个渔场、每艘船只和全球每个海洋的标准。”

paragraphs.en: Stakeholders said the data provides governments with valuable insights to support fisheries management, strengthen ocean governance, and safeguard the livelihoods of coastal communities. "For the first time, satellite imagery and artificial intelligence are giving us an {{16}} view of small-scale fishing activity across African waters, revealing the people, places, and pressures that have long remained hidden," Kroodsma said. "This is about more than technology. It is about {{17}} governments and communities with the information they need to make better decisions for the future of the ocean," he added. Local residents prepare their traditional equipment for a day of fishing in the Indian Ocean in Manguily, Madagascar, April 18, 2026.
paragraphs.cn: 会议的一个关键焦点是越来越多地使用技术来提高海上捕捞活动的可见性。全球渔业观察展示了新研究，利用人工智能和高分辨率卫星图像来揭示传统上超出常规监测系统范围的小规模捕捞活动。首席科学家大卫·克鲁德马在介绍研究结果时表示，分析识别出超过3万艘沿非洲海岸线作业的小型渔船，并指出了工业和手工渔业争夺相同资源的区域。

paragraphs.en:
/CFP
From {{18}} to policy action
Beyond technological innovation, the conference underscored the growing importance of policy reforms, enforcement {{19}} and international partnerships in advancing fisheries transparency. Global Fishing Watch joined partners in the Coalition for Fisheries Transparency to showcase Africa's growing leadership in promoting accountability at sea. Participating governments {{20}} the Mombasa Declaration, reaffirming their commitment to transparency, accountability and cooperation in protecting marine ecosystems and ensuring sustainable fisheries. "The message coming out of Mombasa is clear," Long said. "The future of sustainable fisheries depends on making activities at sea visible and verifiable, and on holding fishers fully accountable."
A major outcome of the conference was the adoption of the Mombasa Declaration, an international call to action on fisheries transparency endorsed by 16 governments from Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, Europe and the Pacific.
paragraphs.cn: 利益相关方表示，这些数据为政府提供了宝贵的见解，以支持渔业管理、加强海洋治理并保障沿海社区的生计。克鲁德马说：“卫星图像和人工智能首次让我们对非洲水域的小规模捕捞活动有了前所未有的了解，揭示了长期隐藏的人群、地点和压力。”他补充道：“这不仅仅是技术问题。这是关于赋予政府和社区所需的信息，以便他们为海洋的未来做出更好的决策。”

paragraphs.en: The declaration commits signatories to improving public access to information on vessel ownership, licensing and fishing activities. It also seeks to strengthen global efforts to combat illegal fishing and promote more {{21}} and sustainable management of marine resources. "From new transparency commitments on vessel tracking to deeper partnerships with governments in Africa and around the world, we're seeing growing recognition that sustainable fisheries begin with knowing who is fishing, where they are operating, and whether they are following the rules," Long added. Among the major announcements made at the conference was Panama's commitment to publicly share vessel monitoring system data from nearly 200 domestic fishing vessels through the Global Fishing Watch platform. The move is expected to significantly increase the transparency and visibility of fishing activity in Panama's waters.
paragraphs.cn: 除了技术创新，会议还强调了政策改革、执法机制和国际伙伴关系在推进渔业透明度方面日益增长的重要性。全球渔业观察与渔业透明度联盟的合作伙伴一起，展示了非洲在促进海上问责方面的领导力。参与政府签署了《蒙巴萨宣言》，重申了他们对透明度、问责和合作的承诺，以保护海洋生态系统并确保可持续渔业。朗说：“来自蒙巴萨的信息很明确。可持续渔业的未来取决于使海上活动可见和可验证，并让渔民完全负责。”会议的一个主要成果是通过了《蒙巴萨宣言》，这是一项关于渔业透明度的国际行动呼吁，得到了来自非洲、亚洲、拉丁美洲和加勒比、欧洲和太平洋的16个政府的支持。

paragraphs.en: Global Fishing Watch's Head of Latin America, Mónica Espinoza Miralles, described the decision as a significant {{22}} in Panama's evolution into a leading advocate for fisheries transparency and accountability. The announcement builds on a partnership launched in 2019 when Panama began publicly sharing tracking data from its international fishing fleet. According to Espinoza Miralles, the country's commitment demonstrates how political will, technology**, and** open data can strengthen fisheries governance and sustainable ocean management. Meanwhile, Madagascar's Ministry of Fisheries and Blue Economy announced plans to expand its partnership with Global Fishing Watch. The initiative will focus on vessel tracking, joint research, capacity building and enhanced monitoring, control and {{23}} operations, placing transparency at the center of the country's fisheries management strategy.
paragraphs.cn: 该宣言承诺签署国改善公众对船舶所有权、许可和捕捞活动信息的获取。它还旨在加强全球打击非法捕捞的努力，并促进更公平和可持续的海洋资源管理。朗补充道：“从关于船舶追踪的新透明度承诺，到与非洲及世界各地政府的更深层次伙伴关系，我们看到了越来越多的认识，即可持续渔业始于知道谁在捕捞、他们在哪里作业以及他们是否遵守规则。”会议上的重大宣布之一是巴拿马承诺通过全球渔业观察平台公开分享近200艘国内渔船的船舶监测系统数据。此举预计将显著提高巴拿马水域捕捞活动的透明度和可见性。

paragraphs.en:
Building the world's most {{24}} fishing map
Conference participants also unveiled a new collaboration aimed at creating the first global map of fishing activity that includes both industrial fleets and small-scale fishing vessels. The initiative will combine vessel-tracking data with advanced satellite imagery and analytics to map millions of artisanal fishing boats that are largely absent from existing datasets. Scheduled for launch on July 1, 2026, the project is expected to provide governments and fisheries managers with a more complete understanding of human activity at sea. Stakeholders say the enhanced visibility will support efforts to combat {{25}}, improve fisheries management, and ensure the long-term {{26}} of marine resources worldwide.
paragraphs.cn: 全球渔业观察拉丁美洲负责人莫妮卡·埃斯皮诺萨·米拉莱斯称这一决定是巴拿马演变为渔业透明度和问责制主要倡导者的重要里程碑。这一宣布建立在2019年启动的伙伴关系基础上，当时巴拿马开始公开分享其国际捕捞船队的追踪数据。据埃斯皮诺萨·米拉莱斯称，该国的承诺展示了政治意愿、技术和开放数据如何加强渔业治理和可持续海洋管理。与此同时，马达加斯加渔业和蓝色经济部宣布计划扩大与全球渔业观察的伙伴关系。该倡议将侧重于船舶追踪、联合研究、能力建设以及加强监测、控制和监视行动，将透明度置于该国渔业管理战略的核心。

articles.fullText:
The 11th Our Ocean Conference, held in Mombasa, Kenya, concluded on Thursday with a call for African countries to accelerate fisheries transparency reforms as part of efforts to strengthen ocean governance, combat illegal fishing and protect the livelihoods of millions in coastal communities.
Held in Africa for the first time, the gathering provided a platform for governments, conservation groups and maritime stakeholders to highlight the growing role of transparency, technology and international cooperation in safeguarding marine resources.
Participants applauded countries such as Ghana and Cameroon for embedding transparency and accountability measures into national and regional fisheries policies.
These efforts are helping African governments translate commitments into concrete actions aimed at tackling illegal, unreported and unregulated fishing while improving enforcement and promoting sustainable fisheries management.
"What we've seen in Mombasa is clear evidence that ocean transparency is becoming a global expectation," said Tony Long, Chief Executive Officer of Global Fishing Watch.
"From new government commitments and partnerships to advances in technology and data, momentum is building around a simple principle: we cannot sustainably manage what we cannot see. The challenge now is to turn that momentum into lasting action and make transparency the standard for every fishery, every vessel and every ocean around the world."
A photo of Amanzimtoti Beach near Durban, South Africa, December 11, 2020. /CFP
Technology driving transparency
A key focus of the conference was the growing use of technology to improve the visibility of fishing activities at sea.
Global Fishing Watch showcased new research using artificial intelligence and high-resolution satellite imagery to reveal small-scale fishing activities that have traditionally remained beyond the reach of conventional monitoring systems.
Presenting the findings, Chief Scientist David Kroodsma said the analysis identified more than 30,000 small-scale fishing vessels operating along Africa's coastline and highlighted areas where industrial and artisanal fisheries compete for the same resources.
Stakeholders said the data provides governments with valuable insights to support fisheries management, strengthen ocean governance, and safeguard the livelihoods of coastal communities.
"For the first time, satellite imagery and artificial intelligence are giving us an unprecedented view of small-scale fishing activity across African waters, revealing the people, places, and pressures that have long remained hidden," Kroodsma said.
"This is about more than technology. It is about empowering governments and communities with the information they need to make better decisions for the future of the ocean," he added.
Local residents prepare their traditional equipment for a day of fishing in the Indian Ocean in Manguily, Madagascar, April 18, 2026. /CFP
From innovation to policy action
Beyond technological innovation, the conference underscored the growing importance of policy reforms, enforcement mechanisms and international partnerships in advancing fisheries transparency.
Global Fishing Watch joined partners in the Coalition for Fisheries Transparency to showcase Africa's growing leadership in promoting accountability at sea.
Participating governments endorsed the Mombasa Declaration, reaffirming their commitment to transparency, accountability and cooperation in protecting marine ecosystems and ensuring sustainable fisheries.
"The message coming out of Mombasa is clear," Long said. "The future of sustainable fisheries depends on making activities at sea visible and verifiable, and on holding fishers fully accountable."
A major outcome of the conference was the adoption of the Mombasa Declaration, an international call to action on fisheries transparency endorsed by 16 governments from Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, Europe and the Pacific.
The declaration commits signatories to improving public access to information on vessel ownership, licensing and fishing activities. It also seeks to strengthen global efforts to combat illegal fishing and promote more equitable and sustainable management of marine resources.
"From new transparency commitments on vessel tracking to deeper partnerships with governments in Africa and around the world, we're seeing growing recognition that sustainable fisheries begin with knowing who is fishing, where they are operating, and whether they are following the rules," Long added.
Among the major announcements made at the conference was Panama's commitment to publicly share vessel monitoring system data from nearly 200 domestic fishing vessels through the Global Fishing Watch platform.
The move is expected to significantly increase the transparency and visibility of fishing activity in Panama's waters.
Global Fishing Watch's Head of Latin America, Mónica Espinoza Miralles, described the decision as a significant milestone in Panama's evolution into a leading advocate for fisheries transparency and accountability.
The announcement builds on a partnership launched in 2019 when Panama began publicly sharing tracking data from its international fishing fleet.
According to Espinoza Miralles, the country's commitment demonstrates how political will, technology**, and** open data can strengthen fisheries governance and sustainable ocean management.
Meanwhile, Madagascar's Ministry of Fisheries and Blue Economy announced plans to expand its partnership with Global Fishing Watch.
The initiative will focus on vessel tracking, joint research, capacity building and enhanced monitoring, control and surveillance operations, placing transparency at the center of the country's fisheries management strategy.
Building the world's most comprehensive fishing map
Conference participants also unveiled a new collaboration aimed at creating the first global map of fishing activity that includes both industrial fleets and small-scale fishing vessels.
The initiative will combine vessel-tracking data with advanced satellite imagery and analytics to map millions of artisanal fishing boats that are largely absent from existing datasets.
Scheduled for launch on July 1, 2026, the project is expected to provide governments and fisheries managers with a more complete understanding of human activity at sea.
Stakeholders say the enhanced visibility will support efforts to combat overfishing, improve fisheries management, and ensure the long-term sustainability of marine resources worldwide.

articles.title: China, Bangladesh to build community with shared future in new era
articles.titleCn: 中国与孟加拉国共建新时代命运共同体
articles.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping met with Bangladeshi Prime Minister Tarique Rahman in Beijing on Friday, with the two leaders announcing the building of a China-Bangladesh community with a shared future in the new era to advance bilateral relations to a higher level.
articles.summaryCn: 中国国家主席习近平与孟加拉国总理塔里克·拉赫曼会晤，宣布共建新时代中孟命运共同体，推动双边关系迈上新台阶。

paragraphs.en:
, Updated 21:32, 26-Jun-2026Chinese President Xi Jinping meets with Bangladeshi Prime Minister Tarique Rahman in Beijing, China, June 26, 2026. /Xinhua
Chinese President Xi Jinping met with Bangladeshi Prime Minister Tarique Rahman in Beijing on Friday, with the two leaders announcing the building of a China-Bangladesh {{0}} with a {{1}} future in the new era to {{2}} bilateral relations to a higher level. Xi said China has always {{3}} great importance to developing relations with Bangladesh and has consistently {{4}} a policy of good-neighborliness and friendship towards the Bangladeshi people. Regardless of changes in the international landscape, China will remain committed to the overall direction of China-Bangladesh friendship and will always be Bangladesh's {{5}} friend, good neighbor and reliable partner, Xi said. Noting that this year marks the 105th {{6}} of the founding of the Communist Party of China (CPC), Xi said that throughout its history, the CPC has united and led the Chinese people in successfully {{7}} a Chinese path to {{8}} from a poor and weak starting point by upholding independence and self-reliance and firmly keeping the nation's development in its own hands. China supports Bangladesh in {{9}} its national independence, {{10}} and {{11}} integrity and opposes external {{12}}, Xi said.
paragraphs.cn: 中国国家主席习近平周五在北京与孟加拉国总理塔里克·拉赫曼会晤，两国领导人宣布共建新时代中孟命运共同体，将双边关系提升至更高水平。习近平表示，中国始终高度重视发展同孟加拉国的关系，一贯对孟加拉国人民奉行睦邻友好政策。无论国际形势如何变化，中国都将坚持中孟友好的大方向，永远是孟加拉国值得信赖的朋友、好邻居和可靠伙伴。习近平指出，今年是中国共产党成立105周年，中国共产党在历史上团结带领中国人民，坚持独立自主、自力更生，牢牢把握国家发展主动权，成功走出了一条从贫弱起点走向现代化的中国道路。中国支持孟加拉国维护国家独立、主权和领土完整，反对外部干涉。

paragraphs.en: Xi said China stands ready to strengthen exchanges with Bangladesh on {{13}}, enhance interactions at all levels, deepen strategic communication and increase political {{14}} trust. He said the two sides should continue to support each other on issues concerning their respective core interests and major concerns. Xi also stressed that China remains committed to fostering an {{15}}, secure and {{16}} neighborhood, as well as upholding the principles of amity, sincerity, mutual benefit and {{17}}. China's new development will continue to create new opportunities and inject fresh {{18}} into neighboring countries, he added. Xi said China supports Bangladesh's new government in its smooth administration and stands ready to carry out high-quality Belt and Road cooperation with Bangladesh, better align development strategies and share development experience. China is willing to map out key cooperation with Bangladesh and tap into the potential for collaboration in green and low-carbon development, digital economy, information technology, artificial intelligence and other fields, expand exchanges in areas including healthcare, culture and education, advance the China-Myanmar-Bangladesh Economic Corridor and strengthen regional connectivity, Xi said.
paragraphs.cn: 习近平表示，中国愿同孟加拉国加强治国理政经验交流，增进各层级交往，深化战略沟通，提升政治互信。双方应继续在涉及彼此核心利益和重大关切的问题上相互支持。习近平还强调，中国致力于营造和睦、安全、繁荣的周边环境，秉持亲诚惠容的周边外交理念。中国的新发展将继续为周边国家创造新机遇、注入新动力。习近平表示，中国支持孟加拉国新政府顺利施政，愿同孟加拉国开展高质量共建“一带一路”合作，更好对接发展战略，分享发展经验。中国愿同孟加拉国规划重点合作领域，挖掘绿色低碳发展、数字经济、信息技术、人工智能等领域的合作潜力，扩大医疗、文化、教育等领域交流，推进中缅孟经济走廊建设，加强区域互联互通。

paragraphs.en:
The two sides should tap the potential for cooperation in green and low-carbon development, the digital economy, information technology and artificial intelligence, expand exchanges in healthcare, culture, education and between local governments,
China is also ready to enhance communication and coordination with Bangladesh within the United Nations and other {{20}} frameworks to jointly promote an equal and orderly multipolar world and a universally beneficial and inclusive economic globalization, while better safeguarding the legitimate rights and interests of both countries and the common interests of the Global South, Xi said. Rahman extended congratulations on the 105th anniversary of the founding of the CPC, saying that China is a great country and has always held an important place in Bangladesh's foreign policy. Describing China as a partner that Bangladesh deeply values and trusts, the Bangladeshi prime minister said he was pleased that bilateral relations had been elevated to a new level with the building of a China-Bangladesh community with a shared future in the new era. Noting China has made remarkable development achievements and Chinese modernization serves as a model for Bangladesh to learn from, Rahman said Bangladesh hopes to strengthen inter-party exchanges with China and deepen cooperation under the Belt and Road Initiative while expanding collaboration in trade, connectivity, agriculture, science and technology, green energy, education, healthcare and other fields to support Bangladesh's modernization. Bangladesh firmly adheres to the one-China principle, recognizes Taiwan as an inalienable part of China's territory, opposes any form of "Taiwan independence," and resolutely upholds the authority of UN General Assembly Resolution 2758, he added. Bangladesh is willing to strengthen coordination and cooperation with China on international and regional affairs to jointly uphold the outcomes of World War II and the international order with the United Nations at its core, Rahman said.
paragraphs.cn: 双方应挖掘绿色低碳发展、数字经济、信息技术和人工智能等领域的合作潜力，扩大医疗、文化、教育及地方政府间交流。习近平表示，中国还愿同孟加拉国在联合国等多边框架内加强沟通协调，共同促进平等有序的世界多极化和普惠包容的经济全球化，更好维护两国合法权益和全球南方共同利益。拉赫曼祝贺中国共产党成立105周年，表示中国是一个伟大的国家，始终在孟加拉国外交政策中占据重要地位。孟加拉国总理称中国是孟方高度重视和信任的伙伴，对双边关系因共建新时代中孟命运共同体而提升至新水平感到高兴。拉赫曼指出，中国取得了显著发展成就，中国式现代化是孟加拉国学习的榜样，孟方希望加强同中国党际交流，深化“一带一路”框架下合作，扩大贸易、互联互通、农业、科技、绿色能源、教育、医疗等领域合作，支持孟加拉国现代化建设。孟加拉国坚定奉行一个中国原则，承认台湾是中国领土不可分割的一部分，反对任何形式的“台独”，坚决维护联合国大会第2758号决议的权威。拉赫曼表示，孟方愿同中方加强国际和地区事务协调合作，共同维护二战胜利成果和以联合国为核心的国际秩序。

, Updated 21:32, 26-Jun-2026Chinese President Xi Jinping meets with Bangladeshi Prime Minister Tarique Rahman in Beijing, China, June 26, 2026. /Xinhua
Chinese President Xi Jinping met with Bangladeshi Prime Minister Tarique Rahman in Beijing on Friday, with the two leaders announcing the building of a China-Bangladesh community with a shared future in the new era to advance bilateral relations to a higher level.
Xi said China has always attached great importance to developing relations with Bangladesh and has consistently pursued a policy of good-neighborliness and friendship towards the Bangladeshi people.
Regardless of changes in the international landscape, China will remain committed to the overall direction of China-Bangladesh friendship and will always be Bangladesh's trustworthy friend, good neighbor and reliable partner, Xi said.
Noting that this year marks the 105th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China (CPC), Xi said that throughout its history, the CPC has united and led the Chinese people in successfully forging a Chinese path to modernization from a poor and weak starting point by upholding independence and self-reliance and firmly keeping the nation's development in its own hands.
China supports Bangladesh in safeguarding its national independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity and opposes external interference, Xi said.
Xi said China stands ready to strengthen exchanges with Bangladesh on governance, enhance interactions at all levels, deepen strategic communication and increase political mutual trust.
He said the two sides should continue to support each other on issues concerning their respective core interests and major concerns.
Xi also stressed that China remains committed to fostering an amicable, secure and prosperous neighborhood, as well as upholding the principles of amity, sincerity, mutual benefit and inclusiveness.
China's new development will continue to create new opportunities and inject fresh momentum into neighboring countries, he added.
Xi said China supports Bangladesh's new government in its smooth administration and stands ready to carry out high-quality Belt and Road cooperation with Bangladesh, better align development strategies and share development experience.
China is willing to map out key cooperation with Bangladesh and tap into the potential for collaboration in green and low-carbon development, digital economy, information technology, artificial intelligence and other fields, expand exchanges in areas including healthcare, culture and education, advance the China-Myanmar-Bangladesh Economic Corridor and strengthen regional connectivity, Xi said.
The two sides should tap the potential for cooperation in green and low-carbon development, the digital economy, information technology and artificial intelligence, expand exchanges in healthcare, culture, education and between local governments,
China is also ready to enhance communication and coordination with Bangladesh within the United Nations and other multilateral frameworks to jointly promote an equal and orderly multipolar world and a universally beneficial and inclusive economic globalization, while better safeguarding the legitimate rights and interests of both countries and the common interests of the Global South, Xi said.
Rahman extended congratulations on the 105th anniversary of the founding of the CPC, saying that China is a great country and has always held an important place in Bangladesh's foreign policy.
Describing China as a partner that Bangladesh deeply values and trusts, the Bangladeshi prime minister said he was pleased that bilateral relations had been elevated to a new level with the building of a China-Bangladesh community with a shared future in the new era.
Noting China has made remarkable development achievements and Chinese modernization serves as a model for Bangladesh to learn from, Rahman said Bangladesh hopes to strengthen inter-party exchanges with China and deepen cooperation under the Belt and Road Initiative while expanding collaboration in trade, connectivity, agriculture, science and technology, green energy, education, healthcare and other fields to support Bangladesh's modernization.
Bangladesh firmly adheres to the one-China principle, recognizes Taiwan as an inalienable part of China's territory, opposes any form of "Taiwan independence," and resolutely upholds the authority of UN General Assembly Resolution 2758, he added.
Bangladesh is willing to strengthen coordination and cooperation with China on international and regional affairs to jointly uphold the outcomes of World War II and the international order with the United Nations at its core, Rahman said.

articles.title: China-Bangladesh economic ties in focus as PM Rahman visits China
articles.titleCn: 孟加拉国总理拉赫曼访华，中孟经济纽带备受关注
articles.summary: Bangladeshi Prime Minister Tarique Rahman arrived in Beijing on Wednesday for an official visit through June 26, his first overseas trip since taking office.
articles.summaryCn: 孟加拉国总理拉赫曼访华聚焦深化中孟经贸合作，涵盖贸易、投资、绿色能源等领域。

paragraphs.en:
A {{0}} of boats are seen {{1}} together as part of a floating fruit market in Rangamati, Bangladesh, on May 30, 2026. / VCG
Bangladesh's Prime Minister Tarique Rahman arrived in Beijing on Wednesday for an official visit through June 26, his first overseas trip since taking office. Before arriving in the Chinese capital, Rahman attended the 17th Annual Meeting of the New Champions, also known as the Summer Davos Forum, in China's northeastern coastal city of Dalian. The gathering brought together political and business leaders from around the world to discuss growth, innovation and emerging technologies. Economic and trade ties have long {{2}} China-Bangladesh relations.
paragraphs.cn:
2026年5月30日，孟加拉国兰加马蒂，一艘艘船只聚集在一起，构成一个浮动水果市场的一部分。/ VCG
孟加拉国总理塔里克·拉赫曼于周三抵达北京，进行至6月26日的正式访问，这是他上任以来的首次海外之行。在抵达中国首都之前，拉赫曼出席了在中国东北沿海城市大连举行的第十七届新领军者年会，即夏季达沃斯论坛。此次会议汇聚了来自世界各地的政商领袖，共同探讨增长、创新和新兴技术。经贸关系长期以来一直是中孟关系的基石。

paragraphs.en:
Since establishing diplomatic ties in 1975, the two countries have steadily expanded cooperation across trade, investment and {{9}}. In 2024, bilateral ties were {{3}} to a comprehensive {{4}} cooperative partnership. Trade lays the foundation
Economic and trade cooperation continues to anchor China-Bangladesh ties. Bangladesh was among the first countries to join the Belt and Road Initiative and has become one of its most active partners. China has been Bangladesh's largest trading partner for 16 consecutive years from 2010 to 2025.
paragraphs.cn:
自1975年建交以来，两国在贸易、投资和基础设施领域的合作稳步扩大。2024年，双边关系提升为全面战略合作伙伴关系。贸易奠定基础
经贸合作继续支撑着中孟关系。孟加拉国是首批加入“一带一路”倡议的国家之一，并已成为其最活跃的合作伙伴之一。从2010年到2025年，中国连续16年保持孟加拉国最大贸易伙伴地位。

paragraphs.en: Bangladesh mainly exports garments and agricultural products to China, while importing machinery, industrial materials and other manufacturing equipment. The textile and apparel industry illustrates the {{5}} nature of the two economies. China supplies machinery and equipment for Bangladesh's textile sector, while Bangladesh exports finished garments and textile products to China. Trade ties received another boost after China granted Bangladesh zero-{{6}} treatment on 100% of tariff lines from December 1, 2024. The policy has made it easier for Bangladeshi agricultural and other products to enter the Chinese market.
paragraphs.cn: 孟加拉国主要向中国出口服装和农产品，同时进口机械、工业材料和其他制造设备。纺织服装业体现了两国经济的互补性。中国为孟加拉国纺织业供应机械和设备，而孟加拉国则向中国出口成衣和纺织品。自2024年12月1日起，中国给予孟加拉国100%税目产品零关税待遇，进一步促进了贸易联系。该政策使孟加拉国农产品及其他产品更容易进入中国市场。

paragraphs.en:
The first shipment of Bangladeshi mangoes to China departs from Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka, Bangladesh, May 28, 2025. / VCG
Investment powers development
As trade continues to grow, investment has become another major {{7}} of bilateral cooperation. China is Bangladesh's second-largest source of foreign investment, according to Chinese Ambassador to Bangladesh Yao Wen. Nearly 700 Chinese companies are registered in the country, with businesses spanning power, energy, transport, textiles and information and communications technology. Their investments have created hundreds of thousands of local jobs, Yao said.
paragraphs.cn:
2025年5月28日，首批孟加拉国芒果从孟加拉国达卡哈兹拉特·沙贾拉勒国际机场启运中国。/ VCG
投资驱动发展
随着贸易持续增长，投资已成为双边合作的另一大支柱。据中国驻孟加拉国大使姚文介绍，中国是孟加拉国第二大外国投资来源国。近700家中国企业在孟加拉国注册，业务涵盖电力、能源、交通、纺织以及信息和通信技术等领域。姚文表示，这些投资已为当地创造了数十万个就业岗位。

paragraphs.en:
Chinese-built power projects, ranging from coal-fired plants to solar and wind farms, now have a combined installed {{8}} of more than 1 gigawatt, helping strengthen Bangladesh's electricity supply and support local industrial development. Ahead of Rahman's visit, Bangladesh approved an infrastructure project for the Chinese Economic and Industrial Zone in Chittagong, according to Reuters. The project is expected to create around 100,000 jobs and attract more than $500 million in foreign direct investment during its initial phase. Future cooperation gathers pace
The visit is expected to inject fresh {{10}} into bilateral cooperation. For Bangladesh, attracting more Chinese investment is high on the agenda.
paragraphs.cn:
中国承建的电力项目，从燃煤电厂到太阳能和风电场，总装机容量已超过1吉瓦，有助于加强孟加拉国的电力供应并支持当地工业发展。据路透社报道，在拉赫曼访华前夕，孟加拉国批准了吉大港中国经济与工业区的基础设施项目。该项目预计将在初期阶段创造约10万个就业岗位，并吸引超过5亿美元的外国直接投资。未来合作加速推进
此次访问预计将为双边合作注入新动力。对孟加拉国而言，吸引更多中国投资是其重要议程。

paragraphs.en: Bangladeshi foreign ministry officials told The Daily Star, one of Bangladesh's top newspapers, that investment promotion will be one of the main priorities during Rahman's visit. The two sides are expected to sign around a dozen {{11}} of understanding covering green energy, electric vehicles, port {{12}} and industrial parks, expanding economic cooperation beyond traditional trade and infrastructure into greener and higher-value sectors. Nahian Rahman Rochi, head of Business Development at the Bangladesh Investment Development Authority, told Xinhua that ensuring {{13}} energy supplies remains one of the country's biggest challenges. He described China as an ideal partner in helping Bangladesh develop solar, wind and hydropower. Bangladesh is also expected to announce its decision to join the Global Development Initiative proposed by China, according to The Daily Star.
paragraphs.cn: 孟加拉国外交部官员向孟加拉国主要报纸《每日星报》表示，投资促进将是拉赫曼此次访问的主要优先事项之一。双方预计将签署约十几份谅解备忘录，涵盖绿色能源、电动汽车、港口现代化和工业园区等领域，将经济合作从传统的贸易和基础设施扩展到更绿色、更高附加值的领域。孟加拉国投资发展局业务发展主管纳希安·拉赫曼·罗奇向新华社表示，确保可持续能源供应仍是该国面临的最大挑战之一。他将中国描述为帮助孟加拉国发展太阳能、风能和水电的理想合作伙伴。据《每日星报》报道，孟加拉国预计还将宣布加入中国提出的全球发展倡议。

paragraphs.en: The {{14}} aims to advance international development cooperation and accelerate the implementation of the UN Sustainable Development Goals. Ahead of Rahman's visit, China said it looks forward to working with Bangladesh's new government to strengthen strategic communication, advance high-quality Belt and Road cooperation, expand practical cooperation and enhance {{15}} on multilateral affairs, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said at a regular press briefing.
paragraphs.cn: 该倡议旨在推进国际发展合作，加速落实联合国可持续发展目标。中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上表示，在拉赫曼访华前夕，中方期待与孟加拉国新政府共同努力，加强战略沟通，推进高质量共建“一带一路”合作，拓展务实合作，加强多边事务协调。

articles.fullText:
A congregation of boats are seen moored together as part of a floating fruit market in Rangamati, Bangladesh, on May 30, 2026. / VCG
Bangladesh's Prime Minister Tarique Rahman arrived in Beijing on Wednesday for an official visit through June 26, his first overseas trip since taking office.
Before arriving in the Chinese capital, Rahman attended the 17th Annual Meeting of the New Champions, also known as the Summer Davos Forum, in China's northeastern coastal city of Dalian. The gathering brought together political and business leaders from around the world to discuss growth, innovation and emerging technologies.
Economic and trade ties have long underpinned China-Bangladesh relations. Since establishing diplomatic ties in 1975, the two countries have steadily expanded cooperation across trade, investment and infrastructure. In 2024, bilateral ties were elevated to a comprehensive strategic cooperative partnership.
Trade lays the foundation
Economic and trade cooperation continues to anchor China-Bangladesh ties. Bangladesh was among the first countries to join the Belt and Road Initiative and has become one of its most active partners.
China has been Bangladesh's largest trading partner for 16 consecutive years from 2010 to 2025.
Bangladesh mainly exports garments and agricultural products to China, while importing machinery, industrial materials and other manufacturing equipment.
The textile and apparel industry illustrates the complementary nature of the two economies. China supplies machinery and equipment for Bangladesh's textile sector, while Bangladesh exports finished garments and textile products to China.
Trade ties received another boost after China granted Bangladesh zero-tariff treatment on 100% of tariff lines from December 1, 2024. The policy has made it easier for Bangladeshi agricultural and other products to enter the Chinese market.
The first shipment of Bangladeshi mangoes to China departs from Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka, Bangladesh, May 28, 2025. / VCG
Investment powers development
As trade continues to grow, investment has become another major pillar of bilateral cooperation.
China is Bangladesh's second-largest source of foreign investment, according to Chinese Ambassador to Bangladesh Yao Wen.
Nearly 700 Chinese companies are registered in the country, with businesses spanning power, energy, transport, textiles and information and communications technology. Their investments have created hundreds of thousands of local jobs, Yao said.
Chinese-built power projects, ranging from coal-fired plants to solar and wind farms, now have a combined installed capacity of more than 1 gigawatt, helping strengthen Bangladesh's electricity supply and support local industrial development.
Ahead of Rahman's visit, Bangladesh approved an infrastructure project for the Chinese Economic and Industrial Zone in Chittagong, according to Reuters. The project is expected to create around 100,000 jobs and attract more than $500 million in foreign direct investment during its initial phase.
Future cooperation gathers pace
The visit is expected to inject fresh momentum into bilateral cooperation.
For Bangladesh, attracting more Chinese investment is high on the agenda. Bangladeshi foreign ministry officials told The Daily Star, one of Bangladesh's top newspapers, that investment promotion will be one of the main priorities during Rahman's visit.
The two sides are expected to sign around a dozen memorandums of understanding covering green energy, electric vehicles, port modernization and industrial parks, expanding economic cooperation beyond traditional trade and infrastructure into greener and higher-value sectors.
Nahian Rahman Rochi, head of Business Development at the Bangladesh Investment Development Authority, told Xinhua that ensuring sustainable energy supplies remains one of the country's biggest challenges. He described China as an ideal partner in helping Bangladesh develop solar, wind and hydropower.
Bangladesh is also expected to announce its decision to join the Global Development Initiative proposed by China, according to The Daily Star. The initiative aims to advance international development cooperation and accelerate the implementation of the UN Sustainable Development Goals.
Ahead of Rahman's visit, China said it looks forward to working with Bangladesh's new government to strengthen strategic communication, advance high-quality Belt and Road cooperation, expand practical cooperation and enhance coordination on multilateral affairs, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said at a regular press briefing.

2026年5月30日，孟加拉国兰加马蒂，一艘艘船只聚集在一起，构成一个浮动水果市场的一部分。/ VCG
孟加拉国总理塔里克·拉赫曼于周三抵达北京，进行至6月26日的正式访问，这是他上任以来的首次海外之行。在抵达中国首都之前，拉赫曼出席了在中国东北沿海城市大连举行的第十七届新领军者年会，即夏季达沃斯论坛。此次会议汇聚了来自世界各地的政商领袖，共同探讨增长、创新和新兴技术。经贸关系长期以来一直是中孟关系的基石。

自1975年建交以来，两国在贸易、投资和基础设施领域的合作稳步扩大。2024年，双边关系提升为全面战略合作伙伴关系。贸易奠定基础
经贸合作继续支撑着中孟关系。孟加拉国是首批加入“一带一路”倡议的国家之一，并已成为其最活跃的合作伙伴之一。从2010年到2025年，中国连续16年保持孟加拉国最大贸易伙伴地位。

孟加拉国主要向中国出口服装和农产品，同时进口机械、工业材料和其他制造设备。纺织服装业体现了两国经济的互补性。中国为孟加拉国纺织业供应机械和设备，而孟加拉国则向中国出口成衣和纺织品。自2024年12月1日起，中国给予孟加拉国100%税目产品零关税待遇，进一步促进了贸易联系。该政策使孟加拉国农产品及其他产品更容易进入中国市场。

2025年5月28日，首批孟加拉国芒果从孟加拉国达卡哈兹拉特·沙贾拉勒国际机场启运中国。/ VCG
投资驱动发展
随着贸易持续增长，投资已成为双边合作的另一大支柱。据中国驻孟加拉国大使姚文介绍，中国是孟加拉国第二大外国投资来源国。近700家中国企业在孟加拉国注册，业务涵盖电力、能源、交通、纺织以及信息和通信技术等领域。姚文表示，这些投资已为当地创造了数十万个就业岗位。

中国承建的电力项目，从燃煤电厂到太阳能和风电场，总装机容量已超过1吉瓦，有助于加强孟加拉国的电力供应并支持当地工业发展。据路透社报道，在拉赫曼访华前夕，孟加拉国批准了吉大港中国经济与工业区的基础设施项目。该项目预计将在初期阶段创造约10万个就业岗位，并吸引超过5亿美元的外国直接投资。未来合作加速推进
此次访问预计将为双边合作注入新动力。对孟加拉国而言，吸引更多中国投资是其重要议程。

孟加拉国外交部官员向孟加拉国主要报纸《每日星报》表示，投资促进将是拉赫曼此次访问的主要优先事项之一。双方预计将签署约十几份谅解备忘录，涵盖绿色能源、电动汽车、港口现代化和工业园区等领域，将经济合作从传统的贸易和基础设施扩展到更绿色、更高附加值的领域。孟加拉国投资发展局业务发展主管纳希安·拉赫曼·罗奇向新华社表示，确保可持续能源供应仍是该国面临的最大挑战之一。他将中国描述为帮助孟加拉国发展太阳能、风能和水电的理想合作伙伴。据《每日星报》报道，孟加拉国预计还将宣布加入中国提出的全球发展倡议。

该倡议旨在推进国际发展合作，加速落实联合国可持续发展目标。中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上表示，在拉赫曼访华前夕，中方期待与孟加拉国新政府共同努力，加强战略沟通，推进高质量共建“一带一路”合作，拓展务实合作，加强多边事务协调。

articles.title: China builds computing network as AI token usage skyrockets
articles.titleCn: 中国建设算力网络应对AI代币使用量激增
articles.summary: As agent-based applications explode, cloud providers are shifting from resource-based billing to token-based metering, directly linking costs to usage volumes.

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, in coding agent scenarios, token consumption can run 10 to 50 times higher than in standard chat due to context {{9}} and search overhead. In China, pricing remains highly {{10}}. Alibaba Cloud's Qwen3.7-Max charges $2.5/$7.5 per million tokens. DeepSeek's V3.1 comes in at 2 yuan ($0.28) per million input tokens and 8 yuan ($1.10) for output – significantly cheaper than most global {{11}}. ByteDance's Doubao Lite is priced even lower, at just 0.3 yuan for input and 0.6 yuan for output per million tokens, while offering generous free {{12}}.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，在编码代理场景中，由于上下文积累和搜索开销，代币消耗量可能比标准对话高出10到50倍。在中国，定价竞争激烈。阿里云的Qwen3.7-Max收费为每百万代币2.5美元（输入）/7.5美元（输出）。DeepSeek的V3.1每百万输入代币仅2元（0.28美元），输出代币8元（1.10美元）——远低于大多数全球竞争对手。字节跳动的豆包Lite定价更低，每百万代币输入仅0.3元、输出0.6元，同时提供慷慨的免费额度。

paragraphs.en: Other domestic providers, including Baidu's ERNIE, Zhipu's GLM, and Moonshot, have adopted similarly {{13}} pricing. But language matters. Chinese text processing consumes 11% to 64% more tokens than English on Claude and GPT models. On domestic models like Qwen and DeepSeek, however, Chinese is actually more token-{{14}} – a {{15}} advantage for local developers. Behind the price tags lies a vast and costly {{16}}.
paragraphs.cn: 其他国内供应商，包括百度的文心、智谱的GLM和月之暗面，也采用了类似的可及性定价。但语言差异不容忽视。在Claude和GPT模型上，中文文本处理消耗的代币比英文多11%至64%。然而，在Qwen和DeepSeek等国内模型上，中文实际上更节省代币——这对本地开发者来说是一个关键优势。价格标签背后是庞大而昂贵的基础设施。

paragraphs.en: As agent-based applications explode, cloud providers are shifting from resource-based billing to token-based {{17}}, directly linking costs to usage volumes. According to industry estimates, monthly token expenses for enterprise users can run into the hundreds of thousands – or even millions – of yuan. To address the long-term {{18}} of AI computing, China is building a national {{19}} computing power network – a unified infrastructure that connects data centers, supercomputing centers, and edge computing facilities across the country, enabling on-demand resource {{20}} much like the national power grid. The network has been {{21}} a key infrastructure project for the 15th Five-Year Plan period, alongside water, power and transport networks. The National Development and Reform Commission has {{22}} that total investment in the network and related fields will exceed 7 trillion yuan ($968 billion) this year.
paragraphs.cn: 随着基于代理的应用爆发，云服务商正从按资源计费转向按代币计量，直接将成本与使用量挂钩。据行业估计，企业用户的月度代币费用可达数十万甚至数百万元。为解决AI计算的长期可持续性问题，中国正在建设全国一体化算力网络——一个连接全国数据中心、超算中心和边缘计算设施的统一基础设施，实现像国家电网一样的按需资源分配。该网络已被列为“十五五”规划期间的关键基础设施项目，与水利、电力和交通网络并列。国家发改委预计，今年该网络及相关领域的总投资将超过7万亿元（9680亿美元）。

paragraphs.en: In telecommunications infrastructure, the foundation for this computing grid is already taking shape. As of April 2026, China had deployed over 5 million 5G base stations, covering 330 cities with 5G-A networks. During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, the network will evolve from "dual-gigabit" to "dual-ten-gigabit," with 500,000 new 5G-A base stations planned. 6G is expected to be commercially launched around 2030, increasing network efficiency and connectivity capacity by more than tenfold. Thousands of low-orbit satellites will also be launched, enabling integrated air-space-ground-sea coverage across the entire territory.
paragraphs.cn: 在电信基础设施方面，这一算力网络的基础已初具规模。截至2026年4月，中国已部署超过500万个5G基站，覆盖330个城市，并建成5G-A网络。在“十五五”规划期间，网络将从“双千兆”演进为“双万兆”，计划新增50万个5G-A基站。6G预计将在2030年左右实现商用，网络效率和连接能力将提升十倍以上。还将发射数千颗低轨卫星，实现全国范围内的空天地海一体化覆盖。

paragraphs.en: The next-generation communication network is expected to drive 7 trillion yuan in total industrial output across upstream and downstream sectors, {{23}} the digital economy, low-altitude economy, and embodied intelligence.
paragraphs.cn: 下一代通信网络预计将带动上下游产业总产出达7万亿元，赋能数字经济、低空经济和具身智能。

articles.fullText:
In May 2024, ByteDance's AI assistant Doubao was consuming around 100 billion tokens per day. By March 2026, that figure had surpassed 120 trillion – a roughly 1,000-fold surge in just two years, according to industry data.
Doubao is far from alone. Across China, daily average token consumption reached 140 trillion in March 2026, up from just 100 billion in early 2024, a more than 1,000-fold increase, according to the National Data Bureau.
The explosive growth reflects the deepening adoption of AI agents and large-scale model applications across industries.
Globally, the trend is equally striking. From training complex models to running AI agents, tokens – the basic units of data processed by large language models – have become a fundamental metric of the AI era. And the world is burning through them at an unprecedented rate.
OpenAI's flagship GPT-5.5 charges $5 per million input tokens and $30 per million output tokens via API. Anthropic's Claude series follows a tiered API pricing structure: Opus 4.8 at $5/$25 per million tokens (input/output), Sonnet 4.6 at $3/$15, and Haiku 4.5 at $1/$5.
Meanwhile, in coding agent scenarios, token consumption can run 10 to 50 times higher than in standard chat due to context accumulation and search overhead.
In China, pricing remains highly competitive. Alibaba Cloud's Qwen3.7-Max charges $2.5/$7.5 per million tokens. DeepSeek's V3.1 comes in at 2 yuan ($0.28) per million input tokens and 8 yuan ($1.10) for output – significantly cheaper than most global counterparts.
ByteDance's Doubao Lite is priced even lower, at just 0.3 yuan for input and 0.6 yuan for output per million tokens, while offering generous free quotas. Other domestic providers, including Baidu's ERNIE, Zhipu's GLM, and Moonshot, have adopted similarly accessible pricing.
But language matters. Chinese text processing consumes 11% to 64% more tokens than English on Claude and GPT models.
On domestic models like Qwen and DeepSeek, however, Chinese is actually more token-efficient – a critical advantage for local developers.
Behind the price tags lies a vast and costly infrastructure. As agent-based applications explode, cloud providers are shifting from resource-based billing to token-based metering, directly linking costs to usage volumes.
According to industry estimates, monthly token expenses for enterprise users can run into the hundreds of thousands – or even millions – of yuan.
To address the long-term sustainability of AI computing, China is building a national integrated computing power network – a unified infrastructure that connects data centers, supercomputing centers, and edge computing facilities across the country, enabling on-demand resource allocation much like the national power grid.
The network has been designated a key infrastructure project for the 15th Five-Year Plan period, alongside water, power and transport networks.
The National Development and Reform Commission has projected that total investment in the network and related fields will exceed 7 trillion yuan ($968 billion) this year.
In telecommunications infrastructure, the foundation for this computing grid is already taking shape. As of April 2026, China had deployed over 5 million 5G base stations, covering 330 cities with 5G-A networks.
During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, the network will evolve from "dual-gigabit" to "dual-ten-gigabit," with 500,000 new 5G-A base stations planned.
6G is expected to be commercially launched around 2030, increasing network efficiency and connectivity capacity by more than tenfold. Thousands of low-orbit satellites will also be launched, enabling integrated air-space-ground-sea coverage across the entire territory.
The next-generation communication network is expected to drive 7 trillion yuan in total industrial output across upstream and downstream sectors, empowering the digital economy, low-altitude economy, and embodied intelligence.
